author: IGN YouTube
text:
Wicker - Official Trailer (2026) Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Peter Dinklage
An audacious comedic fable about sex, marriage, and the absurdities of social convention, WICKER tells the wholly original love story of an ostracized fisherwoman (Olivia Colman) who commissions a husband to be made by the local basketmaker (Peter Dinklage). When her wicker husband (Alexander Skarsgård) proves more spectacular than she ever imagined, his soulful spirit and unique prowess awaken something inside her, setting off a wave of jealousy, fascination, and upheaval that threatens the very fabric of village life.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official 'Losing Ground' Campaign First Look Trailer
Check out the 'Losing Ground' Campaign First Look Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the upcoming installment in the first-person action shooter series developed by Infinity Ward. Players can get a new look at the Campaign mission "Losing Ground" that sees an intense firefight amongst the chaos and destruction of modern warfare. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

text:
Rideshare "Stimulator" - Official Announcement Trailer
Take a look at the Rideshare "Stimulator" announcement trailer for this upcoming driving sim that puts you behind the wheel of your own bustling rideshare business. Rideshare "Stimulator" will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2026.

Welcome to Ottoberg. Would you like us to pick you up? There is currently a driver nearby. 

Dodge traffic and race the clock to get your riders where they need to go. Follow the rules of the road, master your vehicle, and keep your passengers happy to earn good ratings, grow your rideshare business, and upgrade your rides. Don’t get distracted with whatever is happening in the back seat! You never know what stories you’ll hear, from the hilarious to captivating to just plain weird.

Stupid Never Dies - Official Release Date Trailer
Stupid Never Dies gets a new trailer and a release date. Meet Phoenix Zaza Hotfeathers in this Stupid Never Dies release date announcement trailer for this upcoming action RPG. Phoenix Zaza Hotfeathers is a mysterious entity zombie protagonist Davy encounters during his descent. Stupid Never Dies will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC on October 21, 2026.

Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 - Official Snakes Saga Trailer
Check out the Snakes Saga Trailer for Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, the upcoming sequel remastered collection developed by Konami. Players can take a trip down memory lane that all began with Operation Snake Eater during Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater. Snake's story leads into the two additions of the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 with the Peace Walker Project in Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and The Guns of the Patriot Incident in Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots. Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 is launching August 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
